notes: All figures generated programmatically from each problem's own numbers by _gen_diagrams.py, then rendered in-browser and cross-checked against problem text. Theme-safe: text/strokes use currentColor, region fills use soft colours (#60a5fa/#f59e0b/#34d399/#f87171/#a78bfa) at fill-opacity 0.3; no external refs. Sector sweeps for weighted spinners are proportional to the stated probabilities. Without-replacement trees show only the given first-stage fractions and mark the second stage with ? so the figure never reveals the answer. Sample-space grid sums verified (row+col). No question text, solutions, guided_steps, hints, or misconceptions were changed; only SVG prepended to 8 display strings. Chose not to draw: bronze bags of balls (exams describe these in words, not figures), gold three-draw problems (three-stage trees are unwieldy and not standard exam prints), and single-die faces (no exam figure value). Validator PASS; live row PATCHed and re-verified (8 svgs live).
